# Human

<https://info.vizgen.com/access-to-merfish-2.0-data-release?submissionGuid=2bb3c99c-3b3a-407c-bdbf-4e14668c4932>

```{r}
human_metadata = read.csv('data/00_raw_data/202409242358_240916JHHUBC0005XQ-V2V-HubcTMA-V2-BY_VMSC02511_region_R4_cell_metadata.csv', colClasses = c(EntityID = "character"))
human_cell_by_gene = read.csv('data/00_raw_data/202409242358_240916JHHUBC0005XQ-V2V-HubcTMA-V2-BY_VMSC02511_region_R4_cell_by_gene.csv', colClasses = c(cell = "character"))
rownames(human_cell_by_gene) = human_cell_by_gene$cell
human_cell_by_gene = human_cell_by_gene |> 
  dplyr::select(-cell)
# human_cell_by_gene = human_cell_by_gene[,!str_detect('Blank', 
# colnames(human_cell_by_gene))]

human = CreateSeuratObject(counts = t(human_cell_by_gene),
                           meta.data = human_metadata,
                           assay = 'MERFISH')

human_probes = human[str_detect(colnames(human_cell_by_gene),
                                'Blank')]

human = human[!str_detect(colnames(human_cell_by_gene),
                          'Blank')]
# recompute after dropping Blank probes (subsetting doesn't update these)
human$nCount_MERFISH = colSums(x = human[['MERFISH']]$counts)
human$nFeature_MERFISH = colSums(x = human[['MERFISH']]$counts > 0)
```

```{r}
human_parquet = read_parquet('data/00_raw_data/202409242358_240916JHHUBC0005XQ-V2V-HubcTMA-V2-BY_VMSC02511_region_R4_cell_boundaries.parquet')
human_parquet$area = human_parquet$Geometry |> 
  as.list() |> 
  structure(class = 'WKB') |> 
  st_as_sfc() |> 
  st_area() |> 
  as.numeric()

human_parquet = human_parquet |> 
  filter(ZIndex == 0)

geom = st_as_sfc(structure(as.list(human_parquet$Geometry), class = "WKB"))
xy = as.data.frame(st_coordinates(geom))

feat_col = tail(grep("^L", names(xy), value = TRUE), 1)
seg_df = xy |>
  filter(L1 == 1, if ("L3" %in% names(xy)) L2 == 1 else TRUE) |>
  mutate(cell = as.character(human_parquet$EntityID)[.data[[feat_col]]]) |>
  dplyr::select(x = X, y = Y, cell)

# Only cells present in the Seurat object
cells_keep = intersect(unique(seg_df$cell), colnames(human))
seg_df = filter(seg_df, cell %in% cells_keep)

cent_all = st_coordinates(st_centroid(geom))

cent_df = data.frame(x = cent_all[, "X"],
                     y = cent_all[, "Y"],
                     cell = as.character(human_parquet$EntityID)) |>
  filter(cell %in% cells_keep)

fov = CreateFOV(
  coords = list(centroids = CreateCentroids(cent_df),
                segmentation = CreateSegmentation(seg_df)),
  type  = c("centroids", "segmentation"),
  assay = DefaultAssay(human)
)

human[["R4"]] = fov

ImageDimPlot(human, fov = "R4", boundaries = "segmentation",
             group.by = NULL, axes = TRUE)
```

```{r}
nCount_probe_controls = human_probes@assays$MERFISH$counts |> 
  colSums()

keep_cells = bg_filter(nCount_probe_controls = nCount_probe_controls,
                       nCount_transcripts = human$nCount_MERFISH,
                       cell_areas = human_parquet$area[match(colnames(human), as.character(human_parquet$EntityID))],
                       n_genes = dim(human)[1], 
                       n_total_probes = dim(human_probes)[1])
human = human[,keep_cells]

SaveSeuratRds(human, 'data/01_processed_data/01_human_processed.rds')
```

-\> Removed 2,730 low quality cells

```{r}
human = readRDS('data/01_processed_data/01_human_processed.rds')
ImageDimPlot(human, group.by = NULL, axes = TRUE, boundaries = 'segmentation')
```

# Mouse

<https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSM8830801>

```{r}
mouse_metadata = fread('data/00_raw_data/GSM8830802_T2_cell_metadata.csv',  colClasses = list(character = 1))
mouse_cell_by_gene = fread('data/00_raw_data/GSM8830802_T2_cell_by_gene.csv',
                           colClasses = list(character = 1)) |>
  as.data.frame() # data.table drops rownames
rownames(mouse_cell_by_gene) = mouse_cell_by_gene$cell
mouse_cell_by_gene = mouse_cell_by_gene |> 
  dplyr::select(-cell)

mouse = CreateSeuratObject(counts = t(mouse_cell_by_gene),
                           meta.data = mouse_metadata, 
                           assay = 'MERFISH')

mouse_probes = mouse[str_detect(colnames(mouse_cell_by_gene),
                                'Blank')]

mouse = mouse[!str_detect(colnames(mouse_cell_by_gene),
                          'Blank')]
mouse$nCount_MERFISH = colSums(x = mouse[['MERFISH']]$counts)
mouse$nFeature_MERFISH = colSums(x = mouse[['MERFISH']]$counts > 0)

cent_df = data.frame(x = mouse$center_x, 
                     y = mouse$center_y, 
                     cell = colnames(mouse))

mouse[['T2']] = CreateFOV(CreateCentroids(cent_df),
                          type = 'centroids',
                          assay = 'MERFISH')

mouse$area = mouse$volume/(1.5*7)

nCount_probe_controls = mouse_probes@assays$MERFISH$counts |> 
  colSums()

keep_cells = bg_filter(nCount_probe_controls = nCount_probe_controls,
                       nCount_transcripts = mouse$nCount_MERFISH, 
                       cell_areas = mouse$area, 
                       n_genes = dim(mouse)[1],
                       n_total_probes = dim(mouse_probes)[1])
mouse = mouse[,keep_cells]

SaveSeuratRds(mouse, 'data/01_processed_data/01_mouse_processed.rds')
```

-\> Removed 36,942 low quality cells

```{r}
mouse = readRDS('data/01_processed_data/01_mouse_processed.rds')
ImageDimPlot(mouse, group.by = NULL, axes = TRUE, cols = 'white')
```
